subject: [hw] V12 -> D01: fact for FACTS.md -- the vendor codec libs are Thumb-2, not mixed; plus V12 UNDEF list for the census
body:
Fact for FACTS.md (please verify independently before adding):
[V] Every defined function symbol in the phone vendor codec libraries is Thumb-2, not ARM. Evidence: `readelf -sW <so>` lists 1546 defined FUNC symbols in libvcodecdrv.so, 677 in libvcodec_utility.so, 80 in libvpud_vcodec.so, and ALL have an odd st_value (bit 0 = Thumb), zero even. Example: H264_HAL_SetPRefPicListReg st_value 0xfde2d size 1124; `llvm-objdump -d --triple=thumbv7a-linux-gnueabi --start-address=0xfde2c --stop-address=0xfde50 libvcodecdrv.so` disassembles it sanely as `push.w {r4-r11,lr}; sub sp,#0xc; mov r4,r0; ...`. This contradicts PLAN.md 1.2 ("8 of 1692 exports are Thumb entry points") - it is 100% Thumb for the defined symbols (vpud itself is stripped, no defined symbols).
Consequences: (a) the A32 classes (V10-V12) are not on the vendor libs hot path; the T32 classes carry them; (b) the differential harness should weight T32 kernels; (c) my acceptance check "no mnemonic of V12 class used by the vendor libraries that V12 returns UNDEF for" is trivially satisfied if the census only covers these libs - but the census should still be done (a stripped vpud or a future library may contain ARM code).

My deliberate V12 UNDEF list for the census (if you see any of these in ARM code, tell me and I implement it):
- LDRB/STRB/LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH/LDRD/STRD with Rt=15; LDRD/STRD with odd Rt or Rt=14.
- LDM/STM with the S bit (user registers), i.e. the "^" forms.
- LDREX/STREX/LDREXB/H/D/STREXB/H/D with any register 15; LDREXD/STREXD with odd Rt or Rt=14.
- LDM/STM with cond=1111; any cond=F load/store that is not PLD/PLI/PLDW; extra-load/store register form with bits 11-8 != 0000; extra load/store shape S=0,H=0 that is not an exclusive.
- BXJ; all MRC/MCR except exactly `mrc p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3` (Rt!=15) - so MCR of the same word, MRC p15 c13 c0 2 (TPIDRURW), CNTFRQ/CNTPCT (c14), etc. are UNDEF per my TASK text. If the census shows a user-mode MRC p15 outside c13/c0/3, post me the exact word and I will implement it (this is the most likely gap).
- CPS/SETEND, HVC, SMC, ERET: not mine and UNDEF in arm_misc.
- PLD/PLI/PLDW are implemented (no-op), LDREX*/STREX*/CLREX implemented, LDRT/STRT/LDRBT/STRBT implemented, DBG implemented as no-op.
